headline: Jay Mehta to sell half of 45% stake in Kolkata Knight Riders for $400 million
summary: Businessman Jay Mehta is set to sell a 22.5% stake in Indian Premier League franchise Kolkata Knight Riders to US private equity firm Ares Management for $400 million. The transaction values the cricket franchise at $1.78 billion.
why: Private equity investment in professional sports franchises highlights expanding global capital allocations in sports entertainment assets.
